Siren Head Information:

In this addition, Kihec and the creators of Dangers in the Darkness bring you a horror monster legend straight from Trevor Henderson's menagerie of spooky creatures...SIREN HEAD!! 

 

It won't take long before you notice the presence of a towering monster roaming the woods at night. You should be fine if you vacate the area, but when you feel those footsteps and the ground starts shaking, he likely already knows where you are and you should start running, digging or find a mountainside to hide in. Your wood shack won't save you, that's a promise.

 

Best of luck to you all, and don't get eaten.

 

If you don't want your house receiving structural damage, please change destruction to false in the config.

Full page and credits here: Siren Head: The Arrival - Minecraft Mods - CurseForge

One more thing: IF YOU FIND ANY BUGS, OR HAVE ANY SUGGESTIONS PLEACE COMMENT
